SELECT b.id,b.bill_no,b.order_id,b.payable_amount,b.paid_amount,b.status,b.created_at,b.updated_at, o.order_no,o.user_id,o.status AS order_status,o.payable_amount AS order_amount,v.vehicle_no,u.user_name FROM bike_bill b JOIN bike_rental_order o ON o.id=b.order_id JOIN bike_vehicle v ON v.id=o.vehicle_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=o.user_id
AND o.user_id=#{userId} AND b.bill_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{filter.billNo},'%') AND o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{filter.orderNo},'%') AND b.status=#{filter.status} AND u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{filter.userName},'%')
ORDER BY b.id DESC

SELECT p.id,p.payment_no,p.bill_id,p.amount,p.paid_at,b.bill_no,o.order_no FROM bike_payment_record p JOIN bike_bill b ON b.id=p.bill_id JOIN bike_rental_order o ON o.id=b.order_id WHERE o.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY p.id DESC

SELECT b.id,b.bill_no,b.order_id,b.payable_amount,b.paid_amount,b.status,b.created_at,b.updated_at, o.order_no,o.user_id,o.status AS order_status,o.payable_amount AS order_amount FROM bike_bill b JOIN bike_rental_order o ON o.id=b.order_id WHERE b.id=#{billId} AND o.user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
